t: This is a $(l:programming/conditions)Condition/$ widget.$(p)The $(thing)Condition: Item Filter/$ widget allows you to compare $(l:programming/item_filter)Item Filters/$. This is mostly useful when you are using Item Filters with $(l:programming/variables)variables/$.$(p)The widget examines the item in a single $(l:programming/item_filter)Item Filter/$ widget connected on the top row, right-hand side, and checks if that item matches the filter specified by $(thing)Item Filter(s)/$ on the second row.

这是一个$(l:programming/conditions)条件/$元件。$(p)$(thing)条件：物品过滤器/$元件允许你比较$(l:programming/item_filter)物品过滤器/$。当你将物品过滤器与$(l:programming/variables)变量/$配合使用时，这通常会很有用。$(p)该元件会读取连接在上排右侧的单个$(l:programming/item_filter)物品过滤器/$元件中的物品，并检查该物品是否与第二排中由$(thing)物品过滤器/$指定的过滤条件匹配。

As usual, use the right-hand side to whitelist (meaning the item should match this filter), and left-hand side to blacklist (saying that this item should $(italic)not/$ match this filter). If it matches, the condition is evaluated $(thing)true/$. Otherwise, the condition is evaluated $(thing)false/$.
和往常一样，右侧用于加入白名单（表示该物品应与此筛选器匹配），左侧用于加入黑名单（表示该物品$(italic)不/$应与此筛选器匹配）。如果匹配，则该条件会被判定为$(thing)真/$。否则，该条件会被判定为$(thing)假/$。

You can add more than one item to check. By connecting multiple second-row $(l:programming/item_filter)Item Filters/$ on the right-hand side, the condition will only evaluate $(thing)true/$ if $(italic)all/$ items match the filter. $(l:programming/item_filter)Item Filters/$ placed on the left-hand side must $(italic)not/$ match the Filter for the condition to be evaluated $(thing)true/$.

你可以添加多个物品进行检查。通过在右侧连接多个第二排的$(l:programming/item_filter)物品过滤器/$，只有当$(italic)所有/$物品都与过滤器匹配时，该条件才会被判定为$(thing)true/$。放置在左侧的$(l:programming/item_filter)物品过滤器/$则必须$(italic)不/$与过滤器匹配，该条件才会被判定为$(thing)true/$。
